title: EUDI Wallet & eIDAS 2.0 Glossary | Who issues, who provides, who guarantees (pt. 2)
summary: Plain-language definitions of the supply side of the EUDI ecosystem: issuers, wallet providers, trust services and the Art. 5f catalog.
body_markdown:
*EUDI basics, made simple. The supply side of the ecosystem in 3 minutes.*


This glossary defines the supply side of the EUDI Wallet ecosystem under eIDAS 2.0: who issues credentials (issuers), who holds them (holders), who provides the wallet itself (wallet providers), who guarantees that any of it can be trusted (trust service providers, qualified and non-qualified), and which sectors are legally required to accept the wallet (the Article 5f catalog).


[Part 1](https://authologic.com/blog/eudi-eidas-20-glossary-pt1) covered the demand side: relying parties, intermediaries and verifiers.[Part 3](https://authologic.com/blog/eudi-eidas-20-glossary-pt3) opens the wallet itself, and[part 4](https://authologic.com/blog/eudi-eidas-20-glossary-pt4) covers what gives a credential its legal weight. Every term from every glossary is indexed in the[Digital Identity Glossary](https://authologic.com/blog/digital-identity-glossary-index) .
